# T-1: Enforce task cursor

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Promote pending tasks before flow-level implementation actions and reject null currentTaskId when task work remains.

## Acceptance Criteria
- get-next-action promotes the next pending task before flow-level implement/review/gate-impl when task work remains.
- Implementation-phase commands fail with ok:false when task work remains and currentTaskId is null without explicit broad mode.
- Failure output includes recovery guidance for starting or restoring a task cursor.

## Implementation Notes
Focus on dispatcher and command preflight boundaries in get-next-action, run-review, and run-gate. Reuse existing promoteNextPending and flow envelope patterns. Add a small class if a reusable task-scope decision object is needed.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for get-next-action promotion and command preflight rejection with synthetic flow states.
